title: Bondy — bondy_db / oplog / MST
description: Storage & replication stack: Partisan cluster state, AAE/frontier convergence, WAL, applier, core substrate, MST page store and BEAM VM.

panels.title: Scrape up
panels.description: Prometheus can reach the node's Admin API /metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Membership view size
panels.description: partisan_peer_service:members() as seen by each node.

panels.title: Connected peers
panels.description: partisan:nodes() as seen by each node.

panels.title: Cluster health
panels.description: 1 only when every node reaches every member of its view.

panels.title: Peer connectivity matrix
panels.description: One row per (observer node, peer): whether the peer is in the membership view and currently connected.

panels.title: Connected peers over time
panels.description: A dip below (members - 1) means a partition or a disconnected peer.

panels.title: Instances converged
panels.description: Instances whose applied-frontier hash is identical on every selected node (includes solo instances).

panels.title: Instances DIVERGED
panels.description: Instances reporting different applied-frontier hashes across nodes. Transient values during writes are normal; a persistent non-zero value means AAE is not converging.

panels.title: Instances not live
panels.description: Instances still starting or pre_bootstrap (pulling their initial snapshot).

panels.title: Frontier convergence by instance
panels.description: Distinct applied-frontier hashes per instance across the selected nodes vs the number of nodes reporting the instance. 1 distinct hash = IN SYNC (equal frontiers mean the same op-set was applied; compaction-invariant).

panels.title: Sync sessions
panels.description: AAE sync sessions completed per second, by outcome.

panels.title: Peer last-sync age (max per node)
panels.description: Seconds since the oldest (instance, peer) pair last completed a sync.

panels.title: Substrate AE freshness lag (max per namespace)
panels.description: Fed by the same per-shard atomics the auth fence reads.

panels.title: Appends vs applied (per node)
panels.description: Sustained applied < appends means the applier is falling behind (check backpressure and WAL panels).

panels.title: Replication progress — frontier seq total (per node)
panels.description: Sum of applied per-origin sequence numbers. Monotone; a persistent gap between nodes is replication lag.

panels.title: Backpressure & faults
panels.description: Everything here should normally be zero.

panels.title: Live overlay size (top 10 instances)
panels.description: Unapplied events buffered in the write overlay.

panels.title: WAL health (max across instances)
panels.description: Head lag is ms since the newest unfsynced append. Live segments growing without bound means retention cannot keep up.

panels.title: WAL in hard backpressure (instances)
panels.description: Number of WAL writers refusing appends. Should be 0.

panels.title: Pack seals (per kind)
panels.description: seal_incoming = full synchronous seal; seal_roll = cheap synchronous half of an async seal.

panels.title: Integrity: scrub, recoveries & rebuilds
panels.description: Corruption counters should stay flat at zero.
